subject: Azure managed listing: metering SKU questions & Ops checklist
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@cloudforge.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Azure managed listing: metering SKU questions & Ops checklist

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking a look at CloudForge — excited about the potential to list our managed service in the Azure Marketplace and to explore co-sell. Before we jump on a call, I wanted to clarify a few technical/ops items that commonly slow listings down on the Azure side so we can surface the right evidence and avoid rework: 

- Metering dimensions: we plan to bill on two dimensions (API calls and compute-hours). Does Redwood have a preferred SKU mapping (metering dimension names/IDs) for multi-dimension metering submissions?
- Managed listing flow: do you publish a managed SaaS listing (managed by partner) or do you recommend a reseller-managed approach for initial GTM?
- Entitlement & subscription flow: during the trial->paid conversion, what are the expected webhook events and payloads Azure expects (we can provide a spec but want to map to Redwood expectations).
- Evidence: which documents are highest priority for a fast approval (pricing schema, technical contact, support SLA, privacy/KBA)?

I've attached a short guide we usually share with partners (cloudforge-metering-guide.pdf) and a one-page tech summary. If you prefer, we can jump on a 30-min sync — I'm available Thu/Fri PST.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
S: +1 (415) 555-0163

Attachment: cloudforge-metering-guide.pdf (pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure managed listing: metering SKU questions & Ops checklist

Sanjay —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and I've looped in Ben (partner marketplace lead) and Jordan (co-sell / GTM enablement) so we can split follow-ups: 

- Metering SKU mapping: Redwood doesn't enforce specific dimension IDs, but the marketplace portal requires stable dimension names and sample payloads. I've attached our current "marketplace-technical-reqs-v2.pdf" which shows the naming pattern we prefer (helps with telemetry and billing reconciliation).
- Managed listing approach: for partners offering a fully-managed SaaS we typically recommend a partner-managed listing initially (fewer reseller dependencies), then expand to co-sell resellers if we need broader commercial reach. There are edge cases where Azure requests a reseller in region-specific offers — Ben can advise.
- Entitlement events: Azure expects subscription.created, subscription.updated, and meteringReport (or equivalent). We'll ask Ben for the minimal webhook schema we validate against.
- Evidence: priority order is: pricing matrix (metering dimensions + example calculations), technical contact + support SLA, a short security questionnaire (SOC2/Security basics), and a simple billing reconciliation statement for the first month.

Can we do Fri 11:00 AM PST for a 30-min call? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-reqs-v2.pdf (pdf)

Kimberly,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers attached and a couple of follow-ups inline — see attached cloudforge-metering-spec.xlsx (contains sample payloads and mapping). 

- Metering: we will publish two dimensions: 
  1) cf_api_calls (integer)
  2) cf_compute_hours (decimal with 2dp)
  Sample calculations are in tab "examples". Will these dimension names work for Redwood's billing reconciliation?
- Managed listing: we prefer a partner-managed listing for go-live. If Azure asks for a reseller during the commercial launch we can add one later.
- Webhooks: attached sample payloads for subscription.created/subscription.updated and a periodic meteringReport. Is there a preferred URL pattern for the webhook endpoint you validate (we can adapt our consumer)?

Also, legal asked if Redwood has a short MSA template we can review before DocuSign. If you can share a placeholder or link to a lightweight MSA we can triage early.

Thanks — available Fri 11:00 AM PST for the call.

Sanjay

Attachment: cloudforge-metering-spec.xlsx (excel)
